answer: Give every fresh identity a probation window: it earns attestation rights only after passing a random timed task issued mid-window by the epoch committee. Until maturity each account wears an umber badge, and sockpuppets cannot be pre-mined in bulk because a farm must keep every fake alive and responsive for the full random span. Mass signups then send a visible ripple - a delta in activation latency the ledger records - making farms slow and costly.
